question: Where can I find an attraction in the north direction of Shavers Creek Environmental Center, Petersburg, PA, limited to 160 kilometers?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin( geometry :: geography, ( SELECT geometry :: geography FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), 160000 ) AND degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 OR degrees( ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Shavers Creek Environmental Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Petersburg%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry ) ) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5;
